limits: Response class is observed evidence, not proof of a vendor policy or reason for denial.
The ablation is small and shares an IP; it does not exclude timing or cross-request interference.
Container service logs also include preflight requests; benchmark counts come from the 500 append-log records.
Title/metadata-only markers, region restrictions and interactive challenges are not converted into successes.
